plan.title: Create and publish a Dutch auction

steps.note: Start the RFQ project required for the Dutch-auction conversion flow.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Create an RFQ-only project so it can be converted to an auction.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required auction line item.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Add the available QA vendor participants required for publication.
Publish the RFQ that will be converted into the Dutch auction.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Open the converted auction create screen, the supported path to Dutch auctions.

args.goal: On the converted auction create screen, select the Dutch Auction strategy, choose the entity on which offers are based and the event closing condition, configure the Starting Price, Ending Price, Tick Size and Time Difference using the values required by this test case, save the configuration, and stop on the configured auction screen.

steps.note: Configure the Dutch-specific options that no dedicated catalog step exposes.
Assert that the Dutch auction was published successfully.
Open the Responses tab to inspect the Dutch auction oracle.
Verify the Responses view exposes the current round's End Price.
Check for the upcoming-offers section described by the oracle.
Check for the bidder-list section described by the oracle.
